name: Silver Nocking Point
body:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 29
Aura faint transmutation; CL 1st
Slot none; Price 3,150 gp; Weight —
Description
This small silver cylinder is no bigger than a pinhead and is engraved with an Elven aphorism that roughly translates to “unhindered flight.” A silver nocking point can be attached to the string of any bow or crossbow. When using a weapon equipped with a silver nocking point, a character can treat penalties for wind conditions as though they were one step less severe. For example, a character firing a ranged projectile in severe wind conditions would fire at a ranged penalty of –2 instead of –4. Magical wind effects that would normally deflect the projectile (such as fickle windsUM) instead impose only a –8 penalty on the attack roll.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, true strike; Cost 1,575 gp
